test.title: A time when you had to wait a long time for something

document.cue: Describe a time when you had to wait a long time for something.

text: I'd like to talk about the summer after I finished school, when I had to wait almost two months for my university entrance results. I'd applied for a state grant to study computer science, and my whole plan for the future depended on it.

The exam itself took only one day, but the results were published much later, and there was absolutely nothing I could do to speed things up. My friends kept checking the website every few hours, and I'm ashamed to say I did exactly the same, even at two o'clock in the morning.

To keep myself busy, I took a part-time job at my uncle's café. At first I was hopeless — I mixed up orders and dropped a whole tray of glasses — but by August I could handle the lunchtime rush on my own. Those long shifts made the days go by much faster.

In the end, the results came out on a Tuesday evening, and I'd got the grant, although not at my first-choice university. Looking back, what I remember most isn't the relief but the fact that I learned to stop refreshing a page and do something useful instead.
So, oddly enough, that frustrating summer turned out to be one of the most productive of my life.

tips.en: I'm ashamed to say adds a lively, natural-sounding detail.
tips.kk: I'm ashamed to say — табиғи естілетін тірі дерек.
tips.ru: I'm ashamed to say — живая деталь, которая звучит естественно.
tips.example: I'm ashamed to say I did exactly the same

tips.en: Looking back … moves from the story to the conclusion.
tips.ru: Looking back … — переход от истории к выводу.
tips.example: Looking back, what I remember most

note.en: What was awaited and why it mattered — in the first two sentences.
note.kk: Не күтті және неге маңызды — алғашқы екі сөйлемде.
note.ru: Что ждали и почему это важно — в первых двух фразах.

note.en: How long it took and how it felt — shown through an honest, funny detail.
note.kk: Қанша уақыт және не сезінді — шынайы әрі күлкілі дерек арқылы.
note.ru: Как долго и что чувствовал — через честную смешную деталь.

note.en: How the time was filled — the café story with specific mistakes.
note.kk: Уақытты қалай өткізді — кафедегі оқиға және нақты қателіктер.
note.ru: Как занимал себя — история с кафе и конкретными промахами.

note.en: How it ended and what it taught — the main conclusion.
note.kk: Немен аяқталды және неге үйретті — басты қорытынды.
note.ru: Чем закончилось и чему научило — главный вывод.

note.en: A paradoxical ending: an unpleasant summer turned out to be useful.
note.kk: Парадокспен аяқтау: жағымсыз жаз пайдалы болып шықты.
note.ru: Концовка с парадоксом: неприятное лето оказалось полезным.
